body.name: \(I_{\pi}\)
body.type: confidence interval for a log policy value
body.def: On \(N<b_{\beta,D}\log(40m)\), set \(I_{\pi}=G_{\tau}\). Otherwise put \(J^*_{\pi}=[\underline t_{\pi}-\varepsilon_{\tau},\overline t_{\pi}+\varepsilon_{\tau}]\). If \(J^*_{\pi}\cap G_{\tau}\) is nonempty, set \(I_{\pi}=J^*_{\pi}\cap G_{\tau}\); otherwise set \(I_{\pi}\) to the singleton containing the metric projection of the midpoint of \(J^*_{\pi}\) onto \(G_{\tau}\).
body.role: inference output with zero-width off-coverage totalization
